events.verdict: Leonard (LAC) goes to, not through, Williams' (DAL) space and marginal contact occurs as the two come together off-ball.
Collins (LAC) moves laterally into Flagg's (DAL) path and initiates body contact that affects Flagg's SQBR at the end of the drive.
Dunn (LAC) receives the pass in the post and take an additional step before his shot attempt.
Leonard (LAC) and Thompson (DAL) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Leonard (LAC) moves through Powell's (DAL) space and delivers contact that drives Powell off his legally obtained screening position.
Harden (LAC) briefly brings both hands toward Powell (DAL) while moving through the pick, and marginal contact occurs after Powell rolls to the basket.
Zubac (LAC) initiates contact with Flagg's (DAL) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Powell (DAL) stays attached and moves alongside Harden's (LAC) path as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) commits a take foul on Thompson (DAL).
Zubac (LAC) firms up to his left shoulder in Marshall's (DAL) path and absorbs the contact.
Batum (LAC) initiates contact with Flagg's (DAL) arm, and the contact affects his SQBR/ability to control the ball.
Thompson (DAL) fails to legally contest Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt, as he moves into Harden's space during his upward shooting motion.
Batum (LAC) commits a take foul on Marshall (DAL).
